finalText:
**Repeats now drop.** See [router.js:35](src/router.js:35).

State tracks last send time per key. A repeat within 5 minutes returns `[]`. Queued sends count as sent.

`node simulate.js` ran clean. 99 dropped, 0 errors. That matches the 99 flaps in `events.js`.

| channel | count |
|---|---|
| queue | 266 |
| email | 223 |
| pager | 200 |
| sms | 112 |
| push | 112 |

Next: nothing. Say if a repeat at exactly 5 minutes should pass.
